section_summary.extract_value: This abstract reports one study (single sample) validating an Arabic translation of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) in a sample of college-aged women from the United Arab Emirates (n = 256). Exploratory factor analysis supported a one-dimensional BAS-2 factor structure; BAS-2 scores correlated positively with body image measures and body pride but were not associated with BMI. The abstract does not report mean age, mean BMI, racial composition, or the survey administration method.
